name: HY-Motion: Crawling. From a prone position, keep the chest and stomach strictly contacting the floor. The right hand holds a pistol tightly ready across the chest, keeping the right elbow tucked close to the ribs. Drive the forward crawling motion primarily by pulling with the extended left forearm and aggressively pushing off the ground with alternating left and right knees bent outward (frog-kick style). The entire body must drag forward continuously heavily against the floor, keeping the profile extremely flat with zero upward bouncing. Gaze is fixed sharply toward the front target
